source_units.text: Heifers leaped at their feeding troughs; storehouses disappeared, winepresses were demolished, because grain dried up.
source_units.display_text: Heifers leaped at their feeding troughs; storehouses disappeared, winepresses were demolished, because grain dried up.

source_units.text: Their appearance is like the sight of horses; like riders they will pursue.
source_units.display_text: Their appearance is like the sight of horses; like riders they will pursue.

source_units.text: and no one will hold back from his brother. Burdened with their weapons they will go, and among their missiles they will fall, yet they will certainly not be destroyed.
source_units.display_text: and no one will hold back from his brother. Burdened with their weapons they will go, and among their missiles they will fall, yet they will certainly not be destroyed.

source_units.text: Sounds rang out in the Valley of Judgment, because the Lord’s day is near in the Valley of Judgment.

previous_deferrals.source_text: Heifers leaped at their feeding troughs; storehouses disappeared, winepresses were demolished, because grain dried up.
previous_deferrals.reason: The actual unit combines heifers leaping at feeding troughs, vanished storehouses, demolished winepresses and dried grain. No sufficiently particular counterpart was established for that combination; the unit remains pending without importing the familiar wording about rotting seeds.

previous_deferrals.source_text: Their appearance is like the sight of horses; like riders they will pursue.
previous_deferrals.reason: The unit compares appearance to horses and pursuit to riders. The read Nahum candidate supplies general mounted battle imagery but does not establish a sufficiently particular counterpart to these comparisons. The separate proposed Revelation range is unavailable and unread, so the source remains pending.
